title: Despite SEC-004 partial fix, `x-organization-id` header path remains active; INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN not confirmed rotated — spoofed service header can misdirect vCISO data retrieval to wrong org
`BYPASS_PERMISSIONS=true` hardcoded — all authz guards disabled; any authenticated user in any org can read, write, or delete any vendor data via direct resource ID (cross-tenant IDOR)
Analytics aggregation pipelines apply `organizationId` filter but are missing `projectId` sub-filter — new project within org sees org-wide aggregate totals instead of project-scoped zero
API response cache keys constructed without `orgId` prefix — Org A can receive Org B's cached API response when keys collide (e.g., `risks:analytics:${projectId}` shared across orgs)
affectedFiles: All services using Redis response caching

title: Notification events (audit completion, risk threshold breach, policy expiry alerts) broadcast without verifying recipient org matches event org — org-scoped event data exposed cross-tenant via notification payload
Activity log pagination queries do not carry `organizationId` forward across page boundaries — page 2+ may return cross-tenant log entries when per-page query is rebuilt without org filter
GRC Q&A vector store stores document embeddings from all orgs in a shared namespace without org-level partitioning — retrieval query returns cross-tenant document chunks as RAG context
New project compliance dashboard renders `0%` for unconfigured frameworks — metric implies active measurement; expected: "No framework configured" or hidden widget until framework is adopted
